verdict.rationale: Docs show granular control over individual subscription changes (plan/price/quantity, proration, timing) which underlies grandfathering by leaving existing subscriptions untouched, and generic data import/export tools that could be repurposed for bulk cohort updates, but there is no explicit 'versioned plans' feature, no dedicated grandfathering mechanism, and no purpose-built bulk migration tool for moving subscriber cohorts to new pricing. missing for 10: explicit versioned-plan/grandfathering feature, dedicated bulk price-migration tool for cohorts, evidence of at-scale migration workflows.
